This page opens a canvas with real brushes: oil, bristle, scumble, pencil and pen from MyPaint, and watercolor that flows. Paint with your finger, then smudge, erase and undo. Nothing to download or sign up for.

Questions

Is it free?

Yes. Rapier is free and open source, with no account, ads or tracking.

Do I need to download an app?

No. It runs in your browser. On Android you can also install Rapier from Google Play.

Can kids use it?

Yes. There are no ads, accounts or tracking.

Can I save my painting?

Yes. Press Done to download it as JPEG XL, PNG or layers (OpenRaster), or add it to your document.

Paint

Paint with your finger. Brushes are real paint: oil, bristle, marker, pencil, pen and watercolor. Rapier runs its own mobile paint engine and MyPaint brushes. Watercolor spreads and dries. Smudge, smear, blend and erase paint that's already down. A painting is just a picture layer on your canvas, saved losslessly, which you can resize, export or continue painting.
